name: Python versions and runtime pin policy
short_definition: Policy for choosing and pinning CPython versions (3.12–3.14) for greenfield services and workers, including free-threaded (no-GIL) builds, requires-python vs .python-version, and when runtime concurrency stays on the GIL vs moves to free-threading, multiproc, or Rust.
scope_in: CPython version selection; bugfix/security/EOL status; requires-python and uv python pin; free-threading (PEP 703/779) readiness; single-process GIL implications for FastAPI/async workers; interpreter features that affect typing and packaging (deferred annotations on 3.14).
scope_out: Alternate runtimes (PyPy, GraalPy, Jython); embedding/extension C-API deep dives; ASGI server worker topology details (covered by py-asgi-servers); container base-image minutiae beyond version pins; library API changes unrelated to the interpreter.
defaults: Greenfield default: pin CPython 3.13 via .python-version and requires-python = ">=3.13" (or ">=3.12" only when a critical dep or host still needs 3.12 max-compat). Prefer standard GIL-enabled CPython for production FastAPI/async services. Treat free-threaded builds (python3.13t / 3.14t) as opt-in for measured CPU-bound multi-thread workloads after checking extension wheel support (py-free-threading trackers). Do not default to 3.14 for greenfield until the team's key C-extensions and base images are verified; 3.14 is bugfix (released 2025-10-07) and fine for greenfield when deps allow. Never target EOL interpreters (3.9 and older as of 2026-07). Prefer uv-managed CPython installers over system Python for reproducible CI.
decision_gates: Use 3.13: default greenfield app/service when deps support it. Use 3.12: max-compat library or org policy still on 3.12; requires-python ">=3.12" with .python-version 3.12. Use 3.14: greenfield when you need PEP 779 free-threading support status, deferred annotation semantics, concurrent.interpreters, or t-strings, and the dep graph is clean. Use free-threaded build: only after profiling shows GIL-bound multi-thread CPU work; verify numpy/pandas/crypto/etc. free-threading wheels. Stay on GIL + asyncio: I/O-bound APIs (default FastAPI). Hand off to Rust or multiproc: sustained multi-core CPU with incomplete free-threading ecosystem. Avoid <3.12 for new code; avoid 3.10 for new deploys (security-only, EOL ~2026-10).
do_dont: DO: set requires-python lower bound without artificial upper pin unless a known break exists; commit .python-version; run CI on the pinned minor; document free-threading as experimental path on 3.13 and supported path on 3.14; check sysconfig.get_config_var('Py_GIL_DISABLED') / sys._is_gil_enabled() when shipping free-threaded images. DO NOT: pin requires-python = "==3.13.*" casually; mix free-threaded and GIL images without intentional matrix; assume all PyPI wheels are free-threading safe; use 3.14-only language features while requires-python still allows 3.12; rely on system Homebrew/apt Python as the sole CI interpreter without pinning.
code_skeleton:
# .python-version (dev/CI pin — uv python pin 3.13)
3.13

# pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "svc-api"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.13"
dependencies = [
  "fastapi>=0.115",
  "uvicorn[standard]>=0.32",
  "pydantic>=2.10",
]

# Optional runtime probe for free-threaded deploys
import sys
import sysconfig

def runtime_report() -> dict[str, object]:
    return {
        "version": sys.version,
        "gil_disabled_build": sysconfig.get_config_var("Py_GIL_DISABLED") == 1,
        "gil_enabled_now": getattr(sys, "_is_gil_enabled", lambda: True)(),
    }
failure_modes: Production image uses a different minor than local (import/syntax or wheel ABI surprises). Free-threaded image silently re-enables GIL when an unmarked C extension imports, losing expected parallelism. requires-python too wide → CI never tests the floor version. requires-python upper-bounded too aggressively → uv cannot resolve future patch wheels. Team adopts 3.14 syntax (t-strings, bracketless multi-except) while lock/deploy still on 3.12/3.13. Single-threaded free-threaded overhead (~5–10% on 3.14) accepted without multi-thread win.
anti_patterns: Agents must not: invent requires-python = ">=3.8"; use pyenv+poetry version stacks for greenfield; recommend free-threading as default for async HTTP services; generate code that assumes no GIL without a free-threaded runtime check; leave .python-version uncommitted; pin to pre-release 3.15 for production; document Python 2 or 3.9 as supported.
tools: Primary: uv python install/pin, CPython official installs, python.org/devguide version chart. Alternatives: deadsnakes/pyenv only for legacy hosts. Free-threading trackers: py-free-threading.github.io, hugovk free-threaded wheels. Runtime: standard CPython; free-threaded binary suffix t when intentional.
versions_as_of: as_of 2026-07-13 — CPython 3.14.x bugfix (first 3.14.0: 2025-10-07; docs at 3.14.6); 3.13.x bugfix (e.g. 3.13.14); 3.12.x security-only; 3.11/3.10 security; 3.9 EOL 2025-10-31. Free-threading: experimental on 3.13; officially supported on 3.14 (PEP 779). Local research env sample: system Python 3.14.6, project venv Python 3.13.14, uv 0.11.x.
config_snippets:
# .python-version
3.13

# pyproject.toml
[project]
requires-python = ">=3.13"

# CI matrix idea (GitHub Actions)
# strategy.matrix.python-version: ["3.13"]
# optional expand: ["3.12", "3.13"] for libraries

# uv
# uv python install 3.13
# uv python pin 3.13
# uv sync --locked

# Free-threaded install (only when intentional)
# uv python install 3.14t   # or platform installer with free-threaded option
# PYTHON_GIL=0 / -X gil=0 controls runtime GIL on free-threaded builds
deprecation_watch: Do not greenfield on: Python ≤3.11; pyenv-as-primary when uv manages interpreters; free-threaded as silent default; relying on PEP 563 from __future__ import annotations as the only forward-ref strategy when targeting 3.14+ deferred annotations; PGP-signed CPython tarballs (PEP 761 discontinued PGP for official releases).
ts_boundary: Next/TS BFF stays on Node; Python version pin is independent. Contract is OpenAPI/JSON over HTTP, not shared interpreter. Align only on deployment cadence and health checks. Do not couple Node LTS cycles to CPython minors.
rust_boundary: Hand off to Rust (Axum) when: multi-core CPU paths need predictable latency and free-threading + extension ecosystem is incomplete; zero-copy parsers; hot gateways. Stay in Python for LLM/RAG orchestration, data science libs, and I/O-bound APIs even on 3.13 GIL.
supabase_boundary: supabase-py and asyncpg/SQLAlchemy wheels must match the pinned CPython minor in the image. Prefer direct Postgres (asyncpg) for hot paths; Supabase client is fine for admin/auth helpers. Free-threaded: verify asyncpg/psycopg wheel status before enabling no-GIL images that touch Postgres.
boundary_contracts: Document requires-python and runtime image tag in service README; export OpenAPI from FastAPI at the pinned runtime; env vars for PYTHON_GIL only on free-threaded images; migrations remain SQL/Alembic/Supabase — version-independent. No MCP/runtime coupling to CPython minor beyond tool process images.
decision_matrix_row: Runtime version/policy → Python (this item) for service interpreters and workers. TS/Node for BFF/UI. Rust when free-threading still insufficient for CPU-bound multi-core. Choose 3.13 default; 3.12 max-compat; 3.14 when free-threading support or 3.14 language features are deliberate product choices.
threats: Supply-chain: untrusted third-party Python builds. Drift: different minors across staging/prod → subtle bug class. Free-threaded: data races in previously GIL-protected pure-Python shared mutable state; C extensions not marked free-threading-safe. Remote debug interface (PEP 768 on 3.14) if left enabled in multi-tenant hosts.
mitigations: Pin .python-version + requires-python; CI uses uv python install of the pin; production images FROM official/known digests; disable remote debug in locked-down images when appropriate (PYTHON_DISABLE_REMOTE_DEBUG / build flags); treat free-threaded as separate deploy artifact with race-focused tests; never run prod on EOL CPython.
agent_codegen_policy: MUST generate: requires-python ">=3.13" (or ">=3.12" if task says max-compat); .python-version matching the lower bound pin; no 3.14-only syntax unless requires-python ">=3.14". MUST NOT generate: free-threading-required architecture by default; system-python-only setup docs; poetry/pyenv version stacks for greenfield; code that mutates module globals from many threads assuming GIL safety without documentation.
tests_required: Smoke import on pinned version in CI; optional tox/uv matrix for libraries (3.12+3.13); if free-threaded image exists, concurrent stress tests on shared structures and extension imports; assert runtime_report() matches expected GIL mode in deploy checks.
ci_gates: Install pinned Python via uv; uv sync --locked; fail if syntax/features require newer than requires-python; optional weekly job on 3.14 for forward compat; block merges that drop requires-python below 3.12 for greenfield services.
skill_scan_signals: Positive: .python-version present; requires-python ">=3.12" or ">=3.13"; CI uses uv python. Negative: requires-python ">=3.8"/"3.9"; no pin file; poetry+pyenv only; free-threaded flags without tests; comments claiming GIL is gone by default on stock 3.13.
skill_module_bullets: Default greenfield pin: CPython 3.13 (.python-version + requires-python ">=3.13"); use ">=3.12" only for max-compat.
Commit .python-version; manage interpreters with uv python install/pin — not ad-hoc system Python.
Do not upper-bound requires-python unless a proven incompatibility exists.
Free-threading: experimental on 3.13, officially supported on 3.14 (PEP 779) — opt-in only after wheel + race audit; default stays GIL + asyncio for APIs.
Avoid EOL/security-only floors for new services (≤3.11; plan off 3.10 before 2026-10 EOL).
3.14 language features (t-strings, deferred annotations default, concurrent.interpreters) require requires-python ">=3.14" before use.
action_items: Add version-pin section to references/python.md with 3.13 default / 3.12 max-compat table.
Add scan rules for missing .python-version and weak requires-python.
Document free-threading as non-default with tracker links.
Ensure example FastAPI skeleton pins 3.13 via uv.
checklist: requires-python lower bound set; no casual upper pin
CI installs that exact minor via uv
Prod image tag documents CPython minor
Free-threaded only if intentional, tested, and dependency-safe
conflicts_noted: User greenfield opinion prefers 3.13 (or 3.12 max-compat) even though 3.14 is the latest bugfix series as of 2026-07 — treat 3.13 as default stability/ecosystem choice, not ignorance of 3.14. Devguide SVG status chart can lag the supported-versions table; trust the table + python.org downloads. Free-threading single-thread overhead figures vary by platform (~1–10% cited across 3.13–3.14 docs).
